run_nbest_generation: run the rerank_generate CLI to generate n-best translations using a trained fairseq model
run_reranking_pipeline: run the reranking pipeline to preprocess and binarize n-best translations for rescoring
run_bpe_processing: run the rerank_generate script with diff_bpe to apply Byte Pair Encoding to source and target translations
run_right_to_left_reranking: run the reranking pipeline with right-to-left model support for backwards language scoring
run_prefix_constrained_generation: run the rerank_generate CLI with prefix constraints to generate translations with fixed target or source prefixes
